items.name: Roasted sweet potato cubes
items.preparation: roasted/baked, skin on, possibly a light coat of oil

items.name: Scrambled eggs
items.preparation: scrambled, probably cooked with a little butter or oil (counted in the item)

items.name: Strawberry
items.preparation: raw, cut in halves or pieces (about 2 pieces)

scale_cues: I used the square white dinner plate, about 26-27 cm across, and the known size of a single raspberry (about 3-4 g) and blackberry (about 5 g). There is no cutlery or hand in the image.
assumptions: The sweet potato is a cooked weight. Any oil used for roasting is small and is counted in the sweet potato item.
Any butter or oil from scrambling is counted in the egg calories (about 150 kcal per 100 g).
I counted the small egg crumbs scattered on the plate as part of the scrambled egg portion.
The red smears on the plate are berry juice and add almost no calories.
The overhead photo cannot show depth, so I estimated heights for the egg pile and sweet potato cubes.
